RunnerRequest_abort.description:
Usage: Abort the active run and pending input.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Cancellation does not undo already completed side effects.
Effects: Stops goal continuation and builtin work, voids queued input and aborts the run.
Recovery: Inspect state and transcript after uncertainty; recover editor input separately.
RunnerRequest_abort.name: RunnerRequest_abort
RunnerRequest_abort.title: RunnerRequest_abort

RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt.description:
Usage: Abort the current run and submit replacement input asynchronously.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: The reply follows abort but may precede replacement admission; later dispatch errors arrive as prompt_error and prompt_result.
Effects: Stops the active run and schedules replacement input; completed side effects are not undone.
Recovery: Reconcile the clientMessageId and observe prompt_result after uncertainty before resending.
RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt.name: RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt
RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt

RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.description:
Usage: Abort and recover queued input for an editor.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Queue entries are withdrawn before abort so the interrupted run cannot consume them.
Effects: Stops the run and returns steering and follow-up messages; prior effects are not rolled back.
Recovery: Restore the returned messages in the editor; inspect session state if the response was lost.
RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.name: RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue
RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue

RunnerRequest_abort_bash.description:
Usage: Abort the active shell command.

Invariants: Aborting cannot undo effects the command already made.

Recovery: Inspect shell result and external state after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_abort_bash.name: RunnerRequest_abort_bash
RunnerRequest_abort_bash.title: RunnerRequest_abort_bash

RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary.description:

RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary.title: RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary

RunnerRequest_abort_compaction.description:

RunnerRequest_abort_compaction.name: RunnerRequest_abort_compaction
RunnerRequest_abort_compaction.title: RunnerRequest_abort_compaction

RunnerRequest_abort_retry.description:

RunnerRequest_abort_retry.title: RunnerRequest_abort_retry

RunnerRequest_bash.description:
Usage: Execute a shell command while streaming bash_output frames.
Inputs: Supply command and optionally excludeFromContext.
Invariants: Output frames are incremental; the result follows execution.
Effects: Runs a shell command with its ordinary filesystem and process side effects.
Recovery: Inspect external state after uncertainty; rerunning a shell command may duplicate side effects.
RunnerRequest_bash.name: RunnerRequest_bash
RunnerRequest_bash.title: RunnerRequest_bash

RunnerRequest_branch.description:
Usage: Branch from a user entry.
Inputs: Supply entryId.
Invariants: Branching differs from editing the current history leaf; a live run continues normally.
Effects: Changes session branch and returns selected text unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and tree before repeating an uncertain branch.
RunnerRequest_branch.name: RunnerRequest_branch
RunnerRequest_branch.title: RunnerRequest_branch

RunnerRequest_browser_capture.description:
Usage: Capture a view-only image of a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id returned by browser_list.
Invariants: Ownership and target identity are checked at capture time; the image is bounded JPEG data encoded as base64.
Effects: Reads the visible page without input or browser lifecycle changes.
Recovery: List tabs again if the target is unavailable.
RunnerRequest_browser_capture.name: RunnerRequest_browser_capture
RunnerRequest_browser_capture.title: RunnerRequest_browser_capture

RunnerRequest_browser_control.description:
Usage: Send a bounded ordered batch of navigation or input actions to a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id and 1–64 browser control actions in delivery order; navigation accepts HTTP or HTTPS URLs.
Invariants: The entire batch is validated before dispatch. Ownership and exact target identity are rechecked before each action; coordinates use the captured visual viewport in CSS pixels. No exclusive control or agent lock is established.
Effects: Sequentially delivers navigation, mouse, wheel, keyboard, text, or touch input through one CDP session. A failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: A timeout or disconnect leaves partial delivery uncertain; never replay the batch or its remaining actions automatically.
RunnerRequest_browser_control.name: RunnerRequest_browser_control
RunnerRequest_browser_control.title: RunnerRequest_browser_control

RunnerRequest_browser_list.description:
Usage: List the session's live managed Chromium tabs.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Only tabs owned by this session are returned; ids identify exact CDP targets.
Effects: None; this does not start or change a browser.
Recovery: List again when a tab closes or is replaced.
RunnerRequest_browser_list.name: RunnerRequest_browser_list
RunnerRequest_browser_list.title: RunnerRequest_browser_list

RunnerRequest_browser_video_next.description:
Usage: Pull encoded packets from an active video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Packets are bounded and ephemeral; ownership is rechecked.
Effects: Consumes queued packets.
Recovery: Restart the stream after an error or decoder failure.
RunnerRequest_browser_video_next.name: RunnerRequest_browser_video_next
RunnerRequest_browser_video_next.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_next

RunnerRequest_browser_video_start.description:
Usage: Start encoded video for a session-owned tab.
Inputs: Supply the exact discovered target id.
Invariants: Ownership is checked and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Starts an ephemeral bounded video stream.
Recovery: Stop when hidden and start again after disconnect.
RunnerRequest_browser_video_start.name: RunnerRequest_browser_video_start
RunnerRequest_browser_video_start.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_start

RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop.description:
Usage: Stop an encoded video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Only the owning session can stop the stream.
Effects: Releases video resources.
Recovery: Streams expire when the viewer disconnects.
RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop.name: RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop
RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop

RunnerRequest_btw.description:
Usage: Ask a side question or continue an existing record.
Inputs: question is text; omit recordId to start a record.
Invariants: Only one side question runs at a time; deltas and snapshots carry recordId.
Effects: Streams an answer and checkpoints turns to the session history sidecar.
Recovery: Inspect history after an uncertain response before submitting another question.
RunnerRequest_btw.name: RunnerRequest_btw
RunnerRequest_btw.title: RunnerRequest_btw

RunnerRequest_btw_cancel.description:
Usage: Cancel the active side question.
Inputs: Omit recordId to target the active record, or supply its id.
Invariants: cancelled reports whether a matching active request was cancelled.
Effects: Interrupts the answer; its lifecycle is checkpointed.
Recovery: Read history to determine the outcome if the response is lost.
RunnerRequest_btw_cancel.name: RunnerRequest_btw_cancel
RunnerRequest_btw_cancel.title: RunnerRequest_btw_cancel

RunnerRequest_cancel_job.description:
Usage: Request cancellation of a scoped job or service.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot.
Invariants: A cancellation request is not proof that work has stopped; stale identities and forbidden targets fail.
Effects: Signals the selected job or service; already produced output is not rolled back.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot and inspect status after uncertainty; do not reuse an identity from a replaced runner.
RunnerRequest_cancel_job.name: RunnerRequest_cancel_job
RunnerRequest_cancel_job.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_job

RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent.description:
Usage: Hard-cancel an owned running subagent.
Inputs: subagentId identifies the observed spawn.
Invariants: cancelled is false if it is no longer owned or already gone.
Effects: Releases the agent with an abort tombstone and aborts its session.
Recovery: Inspect the roster after an uncertain response; cancellation may already have occurred.
RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent.name: RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent
RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent

RunnerRequest_commit_apply.description:
Usage: Apply a proposed or edited commit plan while the session is settled.
Inputs: plan contains commit groups, dependencies and changelog proposals.
Invariants: Split plans must cover staged files and have valid dependency order.
Effects: Writes changelogs and creates commits; split plans unstage and stage hunks in dependency order.
Recovery: Inspect commits, changelog and index after failure; partial application is not rolled back.
RunnerRequest_commit_apply.name: RunnerRequest_commit_apply
RunnerRequest_commit_apply.title: RunnerRequest_commit_apply

RunnerRequest_commit_plan.description:
Usage: Propose commits for the workspace while the session is settled.
Inputs: Optional context guides the proposal; changelog false disables changelog detection. Optional requestId correlates unsolicited commit_plan_progress frames.
Invariants: Returns null if no staged changes remain after staging the workspace; progress is emitted only when requestId is supplied.
Effects: Stages all workspace changes, including partially staged files; may invoke a model.
Recovery: Inspect the Git index after errors or lost responses; staging is not rolled back.
RunnerRequest_commit_plan.name: RunnerRequest_commit_plan
RunnerRequest_commit_plan.title: RunnerRequest_commit_plan

RunnerRequest_compact.description:
Usage: Compact session context.
Inputs: customInstructions may be omitted.
Invariants: Compaction may be aborted and is not a transcript deletion guarantee.
Effects: Produces and persists a compacted context summary.
Recovery: Inspect session state and history after uncertainty before compacting again.
RunnerRequest_compact.name: RunnerRequest_compact
RunnerRequest_compact.title: RunnerRequest_compact

RunnerRequest_cycle_model.description:
Usage: Cycle the available session models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Result may be null; isScoped reports whether selection used the configured model scope.
Effects: Selects the next model when available.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
RunnerRequest_cycle_model.name: RunnerRequest_cycle_model
RunnerRequest_cycle_model.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_model

RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level.description:
Usage: Cycle available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Null means no level was selected.
Effects: Changes the current thinking level when possible.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level.name: RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level
RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level

RunnerRequest_dictation_start.description:
Usage: Start draft dictation on the runner microphone.
Inputs: captureId is a caller-chosen nonempty correlation id of at most 128 characters.
Invariants: Speech-to-text must be enabled and live voice inactive; frames carry captureId.
Effects: Starts microphone capture and emits state and transcript frames.
Recovery: On disconnect capture stops; observe its end before starting another.
RunnerRequest_dictation_start.name: RunnerRequest_dictation_start
RunnerRequest_dictation_start.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_start

RunnerRequest_dictation_stop.description:
Usage: Stop draft dictation and obtain final text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Final transcription is flushed before returning.
Effects: Stops capture and emits its end frame.
Recovery: Use the correlated end frame if the response is lost.
RunnerRequest_dictation_stop.name: RunnerRequest_dictation_stop
RunnerRequest_dictation_stop.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_stop

RunnerRequest_edit_message.description:
Usage: Prepare a user message for editing by moving the leaf before it.
Inputs: Supply the user message entryId.
Invariants: The session must have no snapshot-busy or pending asynchronous work; the old branch remains in the tree.
Effects: Persists the navigation, but does not submit edited text.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and leaf after uncertainty before editing or resending.
RunnerRequest_edit_message.name: RunnerRequest_edit_message
RunnerRequest_edit_message.title: RunnerRequest_edit_message

RunnerRequest_export_html.description:
Usage: Export the transcript to HTML.
Inputs: outputPath may be omitted to use the default.
Invariants: The result returns the output path.
Effects: Writes an HTML file to disk.
Recovery: Inspect the output path after uncertainty before exporting again.
RunnerRequest_export_html.name: RunnerRequest_export_html
RunnerRequest_export_html.title: RunnerRequest_export_html

RunnerRequest_follow_up.description:
Usage: Enqueue follow-up input.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Acknowledgement follows admission, not completion; the queue is session state.
Effects: Adds follow-up input for the agent.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input and inspect the queue before resubmitting.
RunnerRequest_follow_up.name: RunnerRequest_follow_up
RunnerRequest_follow_up.title: RunnerRequest_follow_up

RunnerRequest_fork.description:
Usage: Fork a session snapshot at an optional entry.
Inputs: entryId may be omitted.
Invariants: The session must be idle for a consistent snapshot; idleness is rechecked after awaits.
Effects: Switches to the fork unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect current session identity after uncertainty; retry session_busy only once work has settled.
RunnerRequest_fork.name: RunnerRequest_fork
RunnerRequest_fork.title: RunnerRequest_fork

RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description.description:
Usage: Generate a PR title and body from the current branch and staged diff.
Inputs: base is a Git ref; context and plannedMessages are optional.
Invariants: Commits are oldest first; the staged diff is bounded and generation requires changes.
Effects: Reads Git and session history and calls the configured model; does not create a PR.
Recovery: Retry generation if needed; output can differ and malformed model output falls back to the log.
RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description.name: RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description
RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description.title: RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description

RunnerRequest_generate_title.description:
Usage: Generate a session title.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The title may be null when none is generated.
Effects: Persists a generated title when available.
Recovery: Inspect the session name after uncertainty before generating again.
RunnerRequest_generate_title.name: RunnerRequest_generate_title
RunnerRequest_generate_title.title: RunnerRequest_generate_title

RunnerRequest_get_available_commands.description:
Usage: List available slash commands.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The list reflects current session capabilities.
Effects: Reads the current command registry.
Recovery: Refresh after extensions or session configuration change.
RunnerRequest_get_available_commands.name: RunnerRequest_get_available_commands
RunnerRequest_get_available_commands.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_commands

RunnerRequest_get_available_models.description:
Usage: List currently available models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery; results reflect the current registry.
Effects: Reads model availability without selecting a model.
Recovery: Refresh after discovery or provider configuration changes.
RunnerRequest_get_available_models.name: RunnerRequest_get_available_models
RunnerRequest_get_available_models.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_models

RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_lev.description:
Usage: List available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Levels reflect the current session model.
Effects: Reads the live model configuration without changing it.
Recovery: Refresh after changing models.
RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_lev.name: RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_levels
RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_lev.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_levels

RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages.description:
Usage: List user messages available for branching.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Entry ids refer to the current session tree.
Effects: Reads branch candidates without navigating.
Recovery: Refresh after session or tree changes.
RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages.name: RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages
RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages.title: RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages

RunnerRequest_get_btw_history.description:
Usage: Read side-question history for the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Records are newest first and include follow-up turns.
Effects: Reads the session history sidecar without changing it.
Recovery: Retry a failed read; history reflects saved checkpoints.
RunnerRequest_get_btw_history.name: RunnerRequest_get_btw_history
RunnerRequest_get_btw_history.title: RunnerRequest_get_btw_history

RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status.description:
Usage: Recover correlation for one to 32 unique client message IDs.
Inputs: Supply unique nonempty IDs up to 128 characters each.
Invariants: Status reflects this session's in-flight and journaled input; bounded responses can omit oversized native messages.
Effects: Reads correlation state without submitting input.
Recovery: Use session history when messages are omitted; do not treat an uncertain transport as proof of non-admission.
RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status.name: RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status
RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status.title: RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status

RunnerRequest_get_entries.description:
Usage: Read session entries after an optional entry cursor.
Inputs: Omit since for all entries, or supply an existing entry id.
Invariants: Results exclude the cursor entry; an unknown id fails with unknown_since.
Effects: Reads the current session entry list and leaf.
Recovery: Restart without a cursor if the cursor is no longer valid.
RunnerRequest_get_entries.name: RunnerRequest_get_entries
RunnerRequest_get_entries.title: RunnerRequest_get_entries

RunnerRequest_get_job_output.description:
Usage: Read one job or service's output.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot; cursor defaults to zero.
Invariants: Identity is bound to the runner generation and job incarnation; bash sources honor the cursor, while service logs and non-stream sources return bounded snapshots from zero. Output may be truncated.
Effects: Reads current output without cancelling the job.
Recovery: On stale_generation or job_not_found refresh the list; invalid_args requires correcting the request.
RunnerRequest_get_job_output.name: RunnerRequest_get_job_output
RunnerRequest_get_job_output.title: RunnerRequest_get_job_output

RunnerRequest_get_jobs.description:
Usage: List jobs and services scoped to the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a live snapshot; a service-list failure appears in servicesError.
Effects: Reads runner and daemon state without starting work.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot after a restart or service-list failure.
RunnerRequest_get_jobs.name: RunnerRequest_get_jobs
RunnerRequest_get_jobs.title: RunnerRequest_get_jobs

RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text.description:
Usage: Read the latest assistant text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Text is omitted when there is no assistant text.
Effects: Reads the current transcript without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after the transcript changes.
RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text.name: RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text
RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text.title: RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text

RunnerRequest_get_login_providers.description:
Usage: List OAuth providers and authentication state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Availability comes from the provider catalog and authentication from credential storage.
Effects: Reads current in-process registry and stored credential state.
Recovery: Refresh the list after login or logout.
RunnerRequest_get_login_providers.name: RunnerRequest_get_login_providers
RunnerRequest_get_login_providers.title: RunnerRequest_get_login_providers

RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts.description:
Usage: List credentials available for provider logout.
Inputs: providerId is required.
Invariants: Accounts are scoped to the requested provider and current session.
Effects: Reads credential storage without removing credentials.
Recovery: Refresh the list before choosing an account.
RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts.name: RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts
RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts.title: RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts

RunnerRequest_get_messages.description:
Usage: Read the live transcript.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is the current in-memory transcript and may change during a run.
Effects: Reads messages without modifying them.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or use bounded paging while idle.
RunnerRequest_get_messages.name: RunnerRequest_get_messages
RunnerRequest_get_messages.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages

RunnerRequest_get_messages_page.description:
Usage: Read a bounded page of the live transcript.
Inputs: Omit cursor for the first page; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 256.
Invariants: Pages are bounded by a byte budget; a transcript change makes cursors stale and streaming or compaction rejects paging.
Effects: Reads an in-memory snapshot without modifying the transcript.
Recovery: Restart from the first page after a stale cursor or once the session is idle.
RunnerRequest_get_messages_page.name: RunnerRequest_get_messages_page
RunnerRequest_get_messages_page.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages_page

RunnerRequest_get_session_lease.description:
Usage: Probe session lease ownership.
Inputs: Supply sessionIds.
Invariants: Held and unknown are separate classifications; unknown is not proof of an available lease.
Effects: Reads lease state without taking a lease.
Recovery: Probe again when unknown ownership can be resolved.
RunnerRequest_get_session_lease.name: RunnerRequest_get_session_lease
RunnerRequest_get_session_lease.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_lease

RunnerRequest_get_session_stats.description:
Usage: Read session usage statistics.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Statistics describe the current session snapshot.
Effects: Reads usage without changing the session.
Recovery: Refresh after further activity.
RunnerRequest_get_session_stats.name: RunnerRequest_get_session_stats
RunnerRequest_get_session_stats.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_stats

RunnerRequest_get_state.description:
Usage: Read live session state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current in-process snapshot, not a durable history or completion guarantee.
Effects: Reads model, queue, goal, tools and activity state without submitting work.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or when state changes.
RunnerRequest_get_state.name: RunnerRequest_get_state
RunnerRequest_get_state.title: RunnerRequest_get_state

RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages.description:
Usage: Incrementally read an owned subagent transcript.
Inputs: Identify it by subagentId or sessionFile; fromByte defaults to zero and is a UTF-8 byte offset.
Invariants: Only current-session-owned transcripts are accessible; only newline-complete entries advance nextByte. An offset past EOF resets to zero.
Effects: Reads the transcript file without modifying it; messages are the message entries in order.
Recovery: Resume at nextByte; on reset discard the old view and rebuild from zero.
RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages.name: RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages
RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages

RunnerRequest_get_subagents.description:
Usage: Inspect the current session's observed subagent roster.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The in-memory roster only knows lifecycle events observed since watching began, ordered by index then id.
Effects: Returns a snapshot without changing subagents.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot; it is not a durable complete history.
RunnerRequest_get_subagents.name: RunnerRequest_get_subagents
RunnerRequest_get_subagents.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagents

RunnerRequest_get_tree.description:
Usage: Read the session tree and current leaf.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current session snapshot and can change with navigation.
Effects: Reads the in-process tree without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after session or leaf changes.
RunnerRequest_get_tree.name: RunnerRequest_get_tree
RunnerRequest_get_tree.title: RunnerRequest_get_tree

RunnerRequest_goal.description:
Usage: Read or control the session goal.
Inputs: Select get, create, resume, pause or drop; objective and token_budget are optional operation inputs.
Invariants: Goal state belongs to the current session; operations have different state preconditions.
Effects: Mutating operations change goal continuation state.
Recovery: Read the goal before retrying an uncertain mutation.
RunnerRequest_goal.name: RunnerRequest_goal
RunnerRequest_goal.title: RunnerRequest_goal

RunnerRequest_handoff.description:
Usage: Compact the current session with an OMP handoff summary.
Inputs: Optional string customInstructions guides the summary.
Invariants: Compaction runs in the background without interrupting an active response. OMP rejects overlapping compaction or a session transition.
Effects: Updates the current session's context, not a separate session. The runner waits for compaction to finish before replying with {}; compaction errors fail the command.
Recovery: If delivery is uncertain, inspect session state and manual_compaction_end before retrying.
RunnerRequest_handoff.name: RunnerRequest_handoff
RunnerRequest_handoff.title: RunnerRequest_handoff

RunnerRequest_live_connect.description:
Usage: Connect live voice using a remote WebRTC offer.
Inputs: sdpOffer must be nonempty; voice and instructions are optional.
Invariants: Dictation must not be active; the returned SDP answer belongs to this connection.
Effects: Starts live voice without opening the runner microphone.
Recovery: A lost answer requires reconciling the active session before reconnecting.
RunnerRequest_live_connect.name: RunnerRequest_live_connect
RunnerRequest_live_connect.title: RunnerRequest_live_connect

RunnerRequest_live_mute.description:
Usage: Control live microphone mute.
Inputs: Supply muted to set it, or omit it to toggle.
Invariants: The result reports the resulting mute state.
Effects: Changes live voice microphone state.
Recovery: After an uncertain toggle, set an explicit state instead of toggling again.
RunnerRequest_live_mute.name: RunnerRequest_live_mute
RunnerRequest_live_mute.title: RunnerRequest_live_mute

RunnerRequest_live_start.description:
Usage: Start live voice using the runner microphone.
Inputs: voice and instructions are optional.
Invariants: Dictation must not be active; only one live session is bound to the session.
Effects: Opens a live voice connection and microphone; delegated work uses session tools.
Recovery: Disconnect stops the live session; reconnect explicitly to resume.
RunnerRequest_live_start.name: RunnerRequest_live_start
RunnerRequest_live_start.title: RunnerRequest_live_start

RunnerRequest_live_stop.description:
Usage: End live voice.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Stops the session bound to this runner session.
Effects: Closes the live connection and microphone if open.
Recovery: Reconnect explicitly to start voice again.
RunnerRequest_live_stop.name: RunnerRequest_live_stop
RunnerRequest_live_stop.title: RunnerRequest_live_stop

RunnerRequest_login.description:
Usage: Authenticate an OAuth provider interactively.
Inputs: providerId names a known provider; answer numeric-id prompts with login_input_response.
Invariants: Prompts time out after ten minutes; omitted or null answers cancel the input.
Effects: Stores credentials, refreshes provider discovery online and refreshes scoped models.
Recovery: Check authentication state after uncertainty; login may have stored credentials before a refresh failed.
RunnerRequest_login.name: RunnerRequest_login
RunnerRequest_login.title: RunnerRequest_login

RunnerRequest_logout.description:
Usage: Remove a stored provider credential.
Inputs: providerId and integer credentialId identify the account.
Invariants: A credential not stored for that provider is an error; remainingSource is optional.
Effects: Removes the credential and updates session authentication.
Recovery: Re-list accounts after an uncertain response rather than assuming removal failed.
RunnerRequest_logout.name: RunnerRequest_logout
RunnerRequest_logout.title: RunnerRequest_logout

RunnerRequest_navigate_tree.description:
Usage: Navigate the session tree, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch.
Inputs: Supply entryId and optional summarize and customInstructions.
Invariants: The entry must exist and the session must be idle; ask re-answer is unsupported over RPC.
Effects: Moves the current leaf and may create a summary unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect the tree and leaf after uncertainty before navigating again.
RunnerRequest_navigate_tree.name: RunnerRequest_navigate_tree
RunnerRequest_navigate_tree.title: RunnerRequest_navigate_tree

RunnerRequest_new_session.description:
Usage: Create a session, optionally linked to a parent.
Inputs: parentSession may be omitted.
Invariants: A cancelled change does not detach the current run.
Effects: On success switches the process to the new session.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before creating another session.
RunnerRequest_new_session.name: RunnerRequest_new_session
RunnerRequest_new_session.title: RunnerRequest_new_session

RunnerRequest_open_session.description:
Usage: Resume the newest nonempty session in a directory or create one.
Inputs: Supply sessionDir and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: Session persistence is required; reopening the active session does not detach its live run.
Effects: May switch or create a session and select its model.
Recovery: Inspect returned identity or current state after uncertainty before reopening.
RunnerRequest_open_session.name: RunnerRequest_open_session
RunnerRequest_open_session.title: RunnerRequest_open_session

RunnerRequest_predict_word.description:
Usage: Request composer ghost text.
Inputs: text and cursor, an in-range UTF-16 offset.
Invariants: Disabled prediction, ineligible cursor positions and superseded waiting requests return null.
Effects: May invoke the configured prediction backend; concurrent typing is coalesced.
Recovery: Request again with current text and cursor rather than applying stale suffixes.
RunnerRequest_predict_word.name: RunnerRequest_predict_word
RunnerRequest_predict_word.title: RunnerRequest_predict_word

RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback.description:
Usage: Report whether a prediction was accepted.
Inputs: text, UTF-16 cursor, suggestion and accepted flag.
Invariants: Feedback is ignored when prediction is off or the cursor is ineligible.
Effects: Sends feedback to the configured prediction backend when applicable.
Recovery: A lost response does not establish whether feedback was recorded.
RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback.name: RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback
RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback.title: RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback

RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message.description:
Usage: Promote a queued message.
Inputs: Supply its message text.
Invariants: The result reports whether a match was promoted.
Effects: Changes the queued message's priority.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response.
RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message.name: RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message
RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message.title: RunnerRequest_promote_queued_message

RunnerRequest_prompt.description:
Usage: Submit user input to the session.
Inputs: Provide message and optional images, clientMessageId and streamingBehavior.
Invariants: The reply acknowledges admission, not completion; local builtins can report agentInvoked without a normal agent turn. A clientMessageId is unique within the session's correlation journal, not a global retry key.
Effects: Runs input hooks and may enqueue or start an agent turn.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated submission with get_client_message_status; observe prompt result and settled state separately.
RunnerRequest_prompt.name: RunnerRequest_prompt
RunnerRequest_prompt.title: RunnerRequest_prompt

RunnerRequest_prompt_literal.description:
Usage: Record text as the first user message of a new task chat.
Inputs: Provide the exact nonblank Brief and optional inline images. Preserve whitespace, slash prefixes and image order.
Invariants: Only an idle chat without user messages or queued input can accept it. Input hooks, slash commands and template expansion do not run. Success confirms the first user message was saved, not that the model completed a turn.
Effects: Submits literal user text through OMP's native input queue and waits for transcript persistence.
Recovery: For literal_delivery_unknown, a timeout or a lost reply, check the linked chat and never resend automatically.
RunnerRequest_prompt_literal.name: RunnerRequest_prompt_literal
RunnerRequest_prompt_literal.title: RunnerRequest_prompt_literal

RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models.description:
Usage: Refresh and list available models from configured providers.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery and serializes explicit registry refreshes; the session and active run remain alive. Discovery and configuration failures reject the command.
Effects: Bypasses discovery caches, refreshes command-backed credentials and updates the live registry and model scope.
Recovery: Check provider configuration and retry after a failure.
RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models.name: RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models
RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models.title: RunnerRequest_refresh_available_models

RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message.description:
Usage: Remove a matching queued message.
Inputs: Supply message text and steering or followUp queue.
Invariants: The result says whether a match was found and includes its images when present.
Effects: Removes the matching queued input.
Recovery: Inspect the queue after an uncertain response before removing again.
RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message.name: RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message
RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message.title: RunnerRequest_remove_queued_message

RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction.description:
Usage: Configure automatic compaction.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This changes the setting, not an existing compaction result.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic compaction.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction.name: RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction
RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction.title: RunnerRequest_set_auto_compaction

RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry.description:
Usage: Configure automatic retry.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: This is separate from aborting a pending retry.
Effects: Enables or disables future automatic retries.
Recovery: Inspect current configuration after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry.name: RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry
RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry.title: RunnerRequest_set_auto_retry

RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming.description:
Usage: Set cache warming mode.
Inputs: mode is off, streaming or idle.
Invariants: The returned mode is the effective setting.
Effects: Changes the session cache warmer configuration.
Recovery: Inspect the current setting after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming.name: RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming
RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming.title: RunnerRequest_set_cache_warming

RunnerRequest_set_event_filter.description:
Usage: Select which native session events are forwarded to this host.
Inputs: events is null for all or an array of event types; messageUpdates optionally selects full or delta.
Invariants: Message ids are assigned even to filtered events; delta is the default mode.
Effects: Changes the in-memory forwarding filter, not the underlying session activity.
Recovery: Reapply the desired filter after reconnect; fetch a snapshot when events may have been missed.
RunnerRequest_set_event_filter.name: RunnerRequest_set_event_filter
RunnerRequest_set_event_filter.title: RunnerRequest_set_event_filter

RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode.description:
Usage: Set fast mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Enabled and active are distinct: the current model determines whether fast mode is active.
Effects: Changes the session fast-mode setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode.name: RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode
RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode.title: RunnerRequest_set_fast_mode

RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode.description:
Usage: Set follow-up queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how follow-up messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode.name: RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode
RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode.title: RunnerRequest_set_follow_up_mode

RunnerRequest_set_host_tools.description:
Usage: Install the host's tool catalog for this session.
Inputs: tools replaces the complete catalog; parameters are tool-defined JSON Schema.
Invariants: Calls and updates are correlated by request id, distinct from toolCallId.
Effects: Refreshes session tools; execution delegates to the connected host.
Recovery: Disconnect fails outstanding calls; reinstall the catalog after reconnect.
RunnerRequest_set_host_tools.name: RunnerRequest_set_host_tools
RunnerRequest_set_host_tools.title: RunnerRequest_set_host_tools

RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.description:
Usage: Register host-owned URI schemes.
Inputs: schemes is the complete replacement list.
Invariants: URI requests are correlated by id; cancellation names the original targetId.
Effects: Changes the process-wide URI router registrations owned by this bridge.
Recovery: Disconnect removes registrations and fails pending requests; register again on reconnect.
RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.name: RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes
RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes.title: RunnerRequest_set_host_uri_schemes

RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode.description:
Usage: Set interrupt mode.
Inputs: mode is immediate or wait.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how the session handles interruptions.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode.name: RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode
RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode.title: RunnerRequest_set_interrupt_mode

RunnerRequest_set_label.description:
Usage: Set or clear an entry label.
Inputs: Supply entryId; omit label to clear it.
Invariants: The entry belongs to the current session tree.
Effects: Changes the entry's label.
Recovery: Read the tree after uncertainty before reapplying.
RunnerRequest_set_label.name: RunnerRequest_set_label
RunnerRequest_set_label.title: RunnerRequest_set_label

RunnerRequest_set_model.description:
Usage: Select an exact provider and model for this session.
Inputs: Supply both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A miss waits for background discovery and refreshes that provider on the session's host before failing.
Effects: Changes the active session model.
Recovery: Read state or available models after an uncertain response before selecting again.
RunnerRequest_set_model.name: RunnerRequest_set_model
RunnerRequest_set_model.title: RunnerRequest_set_model

RunnerRequest_set_session_name.description:
Usage: Set the session title.
Inputs: Supply name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
Invariants: The title belongs to the current session.
Effects: Changes the session name.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty before reapplying.
RunnerRequest_set_session_name.name: RunnerRequest_set_session_name
RunnerRequest_set_session_name.title: RunnerRequest_set_session_name

RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode.description:
Usage: Set slow mode.
Inputs: Supply enabled.
Invariants: Support and scope depend on the current session model.
Effects: Changes the slow-mode setting and returns its effective enabled state.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode.name: RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode
RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode.title: RunnerRequest_set_slow_mode

RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode.description:
Usage: Set steering queue mode.
Inputs: mode is all or one-at-a-time.
Invariants: The setting is session-only and is not persisted.
Effects: Changes how steering messages are consumed.
Recovery: Read state and reapply the desired mode after restart.
RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode.name: RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode
RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode.title: RunnerRequest_set_steering_mode

RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription.description:
Usage: Select subagent event forwarding for this session.
Inputs: level is off, progress, or events.
Invariants: events includes forwarded agent events; progress forwards lifecycle and progress.
Effects: Changes the in-memory subscription level.
Recovery: Reapply the desired level after reconnecting.
RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription.name: RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription
RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription.title: RunnerRequest_set_subagent_subscription

RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level.description:
Usage: Set the thinking level.
Inputs: Supply level.
Invariants: Valid levels depend on the configured model.
Effects: Changes the session thinking setting.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty before reapplying.
RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level.name: RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level
RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level.title: RunnerRequest_set_thinking_level

RunnerRequest_set_todos.description:
Usage: Replace session todo phases.
Inputs: Supply the complete phases array with tasks and statuses.
Invariants: This replaces rather than patches the existing phases.
Effects: Commits the supplied todo state and returns the resulting phases.
Recovery: Read session state after uncertainty before replacing again.
RunnerRequest_set_todos.name: RunnerRequest_set_todos
RunnerRequest_set_todos.title: RunnerRequest_set_todos

RunnerRequest_steer.description:
Usage: Steer the current run.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Admission is ordered with other user input; acknowledgement is not turn completion.
Effects: Delivers or queues steering input after input hooks.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input before sending another.
RunnerRequest_steer.name: RunnerRequest_steer
RunnerRequest_steer.title: RunnerRequest_steer

RunnerRequest_steer_subagent.description:
Usage: Steer an owned running subagent.
Inputs: subagentId and nonblank message.
Invariants: Ownership is rechecked after resolving the live agent; success means acceptance, not completion.
Effects: Sends a steering prompt to that subagent.
Recovery: After an uncertain response inspect its transcript before resending to avoid duplicate steering.
RunnerRequest_steer_subagent.name: RunnerRequest_steer_subagent
RunnerRequest_steer_subagent.title: RunnerRequest_steer_subagent

RunnerRequest_switch_session.description:
Usage: Switch to a session file.
Inputs: Supply sessionPath and optionally both provider and modelId.
Invariants: A cancelled switch leaves the current session in place.
Effects: On success changes session and may detach a live run.
Recovery: Inspect current identity after uncertainty before switching again.
RunnerRequest_switch_session.name: RunnerRequest_switch_session
RunnerRequest_switch_session.title: RunnerRequest_switch_session

RunnerRequest_abort.description:
Usage: Abort the active run and pending input.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Cancellation does not undo already completed side effects.
Effects: Stops goal continuation and builtin work, voids queued input and aborts the run.
Recovery: Inspect state and transcript after uncertainty; recover editor input separately.
RunnerRequest_abort.title: RunnerRequest_abort

RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt.description:
Usage: Abort the current run and submit replacement input asynchronously.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: The reply follows abort but may precede replacement admission; later dispatch errors arrive as prompt_error and prompt_result.
Effects: Stops the active run and schedules replacement input; completed side effects are not undone.
Recovery: Reconcile the clientMessageId and observe prompt_result after uncertainty before resending.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_prompt

RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.description:
Usage: Abort and recover queued input for an editor.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Queue entries are withdrawn before abort so the interrupted run cannot consume them.
Effects: Stops the run and returns steering and follow-up messages; prior effects are not rolled back.
Recovery: Restore the returned messages in the editor; inspect session state if the response was lost.
RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue.title: RunnerRequest_abort_and_restore_queue

RunnerRequest_abort_bash.description:
Usage: Abort the active shell command.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Aborting cannot undo effects the command already made.
Effects: Signals the shell execution to stop.
Recovery: Inspect shell result and external state after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_abort_bash.title: RunnerRequest_abort_bash

RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary.description:
Usage: Abort branch summarization.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This does not undo a summary already completed.
Effects: Signals the active branch summary to stop.
Recovery: Inspect the tree after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary.title: RunnerRequest_abort_branch_summary

RunnerRequest_abort_compaction.description:
Usage: Abort in-flight compaction.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This requests cancellation rather than reversing a completed compaction.
Effects: Signals the compaction operation to stop.
Recovery: Inspect compaction state and history after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_abort_compaction.title: RunnerRequest_abort_compaction

RunnerRequest_abort_retry.description:
Usage: Abort a pending retry.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Already completed work is not rolled back.
Effects: Signals the pending retry to stop.
Recovery: Inspect session activity after uncertainty.
RunnerRequest_abort_retry.title: RunnerRequest_abort_retry

RunnerRequest_bash.description:
Usage: Execute a shell command while streaming bash_output frames.
Inputs: Supply command and optionally excludeFromContext.
Invariants: Output frames are incremental; the result follows execution.
Effects: Runs a shell command with its ordinary filesystem and process side effects.
Recovery: Inspect external state after uncertainty; rerunning a shell command may duplicate side effects.
RunnerRequest_bash.title: RunnerRequest_bash

RunnerRequest_branch.description:
Usage: Branch from a user entry.
Inputs: Supply entryId.
Invariants: Branching differs from editing the current history leaf; a live run continues normally.
Effects: Changes session branch and returns selected text unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and tree before repeating an uncertain branch.
RunnerRequest_branch.title: RunnerRequest_branch

RunnerRequest_browser_capture.description:
Usage: Capture a view-only image of a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id returned by browser_list.
Invariants: Ownership and target identity are checked at capture time; the image is bounded JPEG data encoded as base64.
Effects: Reads the visible page without input or browser lifecycle changes.
Recovery: List tabs again if the target is unavailable.
RunnerRequest_browser_capture.title: RunnerRequest_browser_capture

RunnerRequest_browser_control.description:
Usage: Send a bounded ordered batch of navigation or input actions to a session-owned Chromium tab.
Inputs: Provide the exact target id and 1–64 browser control actions in delivery order; navigation accepts HTTP or HTTPS URLs.
Invariants: The entire batch is validated before dispatch. Ownership and exact target identity are rechecked before each action; coordinates use the captured visual viewport in CSS pixels. No exclusive control or agent lock is established.
Effects: Sequentially delivers navigation, mouse, wheel, keyboard, text, or touch input through one CDP session. A failure stops the batch and may leave an applied prefix.
Recovery: A timeout or disconnect leaves partial delivery uncertain; never replay the batch or its remaining actions automatically.

args.description: A bounded ordered batch addressed to one exact session-owned Chromium target. HTTP request bodies are limited to 1 MiB. No atomicity or exclusive control against other viewers or the agent is promised.

actions.description: Actions applied sequentially in array order after whole-batch validation. Ownership is rechecked before each action. Failure may leave an applied prefix; never retry the batch automatically.

buttons.description: Pressed mouse buttons as the DOM/CDP bitmask: left 1, right 2, middle 4, back 8, forward 16.

modifiers.description: CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.
CDP modifier bitmask: Alt 1, Ctrl 2, Meta 4, Shift 8.

items.description: A single browser navigation or input action. Coordinates are visual viewport CSS pixels; touch points are the contacts remaining after the event.

RunnerRequest_browser_control.title: RunnerRequest_browser_control

RunnerRequest_browser_list.description:
Usage: List the session's live managed Chromium tabs.
Inputs: None.
Invariants: Only tabs owned by this session are returned; ids identify exact CDP targets.
Effects: None; this does not start or change a browser.
Recovery: List again when a tab closes or is replaced.
RunnerRequest_browser_list.title: RunnerRequest_browser_list

RunnerRequest_browser_video_next.description:
Usage: Pull encoded packets from an active video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Packets are bounded and ephemeral; ownership is rechecked.
Effects: Consumes queued packets.
Recovery: Restart the stream after an error or decoder failure.

args.description: Read or release a video lease for its exact session-owned tab.

RunnerRequest_browser_video_next.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_next

RunnerRequest_browser_video_start.description:
Usage: Start encoded video for a session-owned tab.
Inputs: Supply the exact discovered target id.
Invariants: Ownership is checked and no CDP endpoint is exposed.
Effects: Starts an ephemeral bounded video stream.
Recovery: Stop when hidden and start again after disconnect.

args.description: Start an ephemeral video lease for this session-owned tab.

RunnerRequest_browser_video_start.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_start

RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop.description:
Usage: Stop an encoded video stream.
Inputs: Supply its target id and stream id.
Invariants: Only the owning session can stop the stream.
Effects: Releases video resources.
Recovery: Streams expire when the viewer disconnects.

args.description: Read or release a video lease for its exact session-owned tab.

RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop.title: RunnerRequest_browser_video_stop

RunnerRequest_btw.description:
Usage: Ask a side question or continue an existing record.
Inputs: question is text; omit recordId to start a record.
Invariants: Only one side question runs at a time; deltas and snapshots carry recordId.
Effects: Streams an answer and checkpoints turns to the session history sidecar.
Recovery: Inspect history after an uncertain response before submitting another question.
RunnerRequest_btw.title: RunnerRequest_btw

RunnerRequest_btw_cancel.description:
Usage: Cancel the active side question.
Inputs: Omit recordId to target the active record, or supply its id.
Invariants: cancelled reports whether a matching active request was cancelled.
Effects: Interrupts the answer; its lifecycle is checkpointed.
Recovery: Read history to determine the outcome if the response is lost.
RunnerRequest_btw_cancel.title: RunnerRequest_btw_cancel

RunnerRequest_cancel_job.description:
Usage: Request cancellation of a scoped job or service.
Inputs: Supply its id, kind, incarnation and generation from a current snapshot.
Invariants: A cancellation request is not proof that work has stopped; stale identities and forbidden targets fail.
Effects: Signals the selected job or service; already produced output is not rolled back.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot and inspect status after uncertainty; do not reuse an identity from a replaced runner.

generation.description: Runner generation from the job snapshot.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

RunnerRequest_cancel_job.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_job

RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent.description:
Usage: Hard-cancel an owned running subagent.
Inputs: subagentId identifies the observed spawn.
Invariants: cancelled is false if it is no longer owned or already gone.
Effects: Releases the agent with an abort tombstone and aborts its session.
Recovery: Inspect the roster after an uncertain response; cancellation may already have occurred.
RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent.title: RunnerRequest_cancel_subagent

RunnerRequest_commit_apply.description:
Usage: Apply a proposed or edited commit plan while the session is settled.
Inputs: plan contains commit groups, dependencies and changelog proposals.
Invariants: Split plans must cover staged files and have valid dependency order.
Effects: Writes changelogs and creates commits; split plans unstage and stage hunks in dependency order.
Recovery: Inspect commits, changelog and index after failure; partial application is not rolled back.

plan.description: Generated single or split commit plan, its changelog edits, warnings and fallback indicator.

items.description: Proposed changelog entries and optional deletions grouped by section for a repository path.
Proposed commit message and files, optionally narrowing changes to hunks and declaring dependencies on other commits.

end.description: Inclusive end line; must be at least start.

items.description: Select all changes, one-based hunk indices, or an inclusive line range in a repository-relative file.

RunnerRequest_commit_apply.title: RunnerRequest_commit_apply

RunnerRequest_commit_plan.description:
Usage: Propose commits for the workspace while the session is settled.
Inputs: Optional context guides the proposal; changelog false disables changelog detection. Optional requestId correlates unsolicited commit_plan_progress frames.
Invariants: Returns null if no staged changes remain after staging the workspace; progress is emitted only when requestId is supplied.
Effects: Stages all workspace changes, including partially staged files; may invoke a model.
Recovery: Inspect the Git index after errors or lost responses; staging is not rolled back.
RunnerRequest_commit_plan.title: RunnerRequest_commit_plan

RunnerRequest_compact.description:
Usage: Compact session context.
Inputs: customInstructions may be omitted.
Invariants: Compaction may be aborted and is not a transcript deletion guarantee.
Effects: Produces and persists a compacted context summary.
Recovery: Inspect session state and history after uncertainty before compacting again.
RunnerRequest_compact.title: RunnerRequest_compact

RunnerRequest_cycle_model.description:
Usage: Cycle the available session models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Result may be null; isScoped reports whether selection used the configured model scope.
Effects: Selects the next model when available.
Recovery: Read current state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
RunnerRequest_cycle_model.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_model

RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level.description:
Usage: Cycle available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Null means no level was selected.
Effects: Changes the current thinking level when possible.
Recovery: Read state after uncertainty rather than cycling again blindly.
RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level.title: RunnerRequest_cycle_thinking_level

RunnerRequest_dictation_start.description:
Usage: Start draft dictation on the runner microphone.
Inputs: captureId is a caller-chosen nonempty correlation id of at most 128 characters.
Invariants: Speech-to-text must be enabled and live voice inactive; frames carry captureId.
Effects: Starts microphone capture and emits state and transcript frames.
Recovery: On disconnect capture stops; observe its end before starting another.
RunnerRequest_dictation_start.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_start

RunnerRequest_dictation_stop.description:
Usage: Stop draft dictation and obtain final text.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Final transcription is flushed before returning.
Effects: Stops capture and emits its end frame.
Recovery: Use the correlated end frame if the response is lost.
RunnerRequest_dictation_stop.title: RunnerRequest_dictation_stop

RunnerRequest_edit_message.description:
Usage: Prepare a user message for editing by moving the leaf before it.
Inputs: Supply the user message entryId.
Invariants: The session must have no snapshot-busy or pending asynchronous work; the old branch remains in the tree.
Effects: Persists the navigation, but does not submit edited text.
Recovery: Inspect session identity and leaf after uncertainty before editing or resending.
RunnerRequest_edit_message.title: RunnerRequest_edit_message

RunnerRequest_export_html.description:
Usage: Export the transcript to HTML.
Inputs: outputPath may be omitted to use the default.
Invariants: The result returns the output path.
Effects: Writes an HTML file to disk.
Recovery: Inspect the output path after uncertainty before exporting again.
RunnerRequest_export_html.title: RunnerRequest_export_html

RunnerRequest_follow_up.description:
Usage: Enqueue follow-up input.
Inputs: Provide message, optional images and clientMessageId.
Invariants: Acknowledgement follows admission, not completion; the queue is session state.
Effects: Adds follow-up input for the agent.
Recovery: Reconcile an uncertain correlated input and inspect the queue before resubmitting.

clientMessageId.description: Session-scoped correlation identity; use status reconciliation after uncertain delivery.

images.description: Optional inline image content accompanying the input.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data.

mimeType.description: Image media type.

message.description: User input text submitted to the session.

RunnerRequest_follow_up.title: RunnerRequest_follow_up

RunnerRequest_fork.description:
Usage: Fork a session snapshot at an optional entry.
Inputs: entryId may be omitted.
Invariants: The session must be idle for a consistent snapshot; idleness is rechecked after awaits.
Effects: Switches to the fork unless cancelled.
Recovery: Inspect current session identity after uncertainty; retry session_busy only once work has settled.
RunnerRequest_fork.title: RunnerRequest_fork

RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description.description:
Usage: Generate a PR title and body from the current branch and staged diff.
Inputs: base is a Git ref; context and plannedMessages are optional.
Invariants: Commits are oldest first; the staged diff is bounded and generation requires changes.
Effects: Reads Git and session history and calls the configured model; does not create a PR.
Recovery: Retry generation if needed; output can differ and malformed model output falls back to the log.
RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description.title: RunnerRequest_generate_pr_description

RunnerRequest_generate_title.description:
Usage: Generate a session title.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The title may be null when none is generated.
Effects: Persists a generated title when available.
Recovery: Inspect the session name after uncertainty before generating again.
RunnerRequest_generate_title.title: RunnerRequest_generate_title

RunnerRequest_get_available_commands.description:
Usage: List available slash commands.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The list reflects current session capabilities.
Effects: Reads the current command registry.
Recovery: Refresh after extensions or session configuration change.
RunnerRequest_get_available_commands.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_commands

RunnerRequest_get_available_models.description:
Usage: List currently available models.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Waits for background discovery; results reflect the current registry.
Effects: Reads model availability without selecting a model.
Recovery: Refresh after discovery or provider configuration changes.
RunnerRequest_get_available_models.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_models

RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_lev.description:
Usage: List available thinking levels.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Levels reflect the current session model.
Effects: Reads the live model configuration without changing it.
Recovery: Refresh after changing models.
RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_lev.title: RunnerRequest_get_available_thinking_levels

RunnerRequest_get_branch_messages.description:
Usage: List user messages available for branching.

Effects: Reads branch candidates without navigating.

RunnerRequest_get_btw_history.description:
Usage: Read side-question history for the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.

Effects: Reads the session history sidecar without changing it.
Recovery: Retry a failed read; history reflects saved checkpoints.
RunnerRequest_get_btw_history.title: RunnerRequest_get_btw_history

RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status.description:
Usage: Recover correlation for one to 32 unique client message IDs.
Inputs: Supply unique nonempty IDs up to 128 characters each.
Invariants: Status reflects this session's in-flight and journaled input; bounded responses can omit oversized native messages.
Effects: Reads correlation state without submitting input.

RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status.title: RunnerRequest_get_client_message_status

RunnerRequest_get_entries.description:
Usage: Read session entries after an optional entry cursor.

RunnerRequest_get_job_output.description:

Invariants: Identity is bound to the runner generation and job incarnation; bash sources honor the cursor, while service logs and non-stream sources return bounded snapshots from zero. Output may be truncated.
Effects: Reads current output without cancelling the job.
Recovery: On stale_generation or job_not_found refresh the list; invalid_args requires correcting the request.

incarnation.description: Identity token from the job snapshot; detects replacement.

RunnerRequest_get_job_output.title: RunnerRequest_get_job_output

RunnerRequest_get_jobs.description:
Usage: List jobs and services scoped to the current session.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a live snapshot; a service-list failure appears in servicesError.
Effects: Reads runner and daemon state without starting work.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot after a restart or service-list failure.
RunnerRequest_get_jobs.title: RunnerRequest_get_jobs

RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text.description:
Usage: Read the latest assistant text.
Inputs: No arguments.

Effects: Reads the current transcript without modifying it.
Recovery: Refresh after the transcript changes.
RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text.title: RunnerRequest_get_last_assistant_text

RunnerRequest_get_login_providers.description:
Usage: List OAuth providers and authentication state.

Effects: Reads current in-process registry and stored credential state.
Recovery: Refresh the list after login or logout.
RunnerRequest_get_login_providers.title: RunnerRequest_get_login_providers

RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts.description:
Usage: List credentials available for provider logout.
Inputs: providerId is required.
Invariants: Accounts are scoped to the requested provider and current session.
Effects: Reads credential storage without removing credentials.
Recovery: Refresh the list before choosing an account.
RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts.title: RunnerRequest_get_logout_accounts

RunnerRequest_get_messages.description:
Usage: Read the live transcript.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is the current in-memory transcript and may change during a run.
Effects: Reads messages without modifying them.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or use bounded paging while idle.
RunnerRequest_get_messages.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages

RunnerRequest_get_messages_page.description:
Usage: Read a bounded page of the live transcript.
Inputs: Omit cursor for the first page; limit defaults to 100 and is at most 256.
Invariants: Pages are bounded by a byte budget; a transcript change makes cursors stale and streaming or compaction rejects paging.
Effects: Reads an in-memory snapshot without modifying the transcript.
Recovery: Restart from the first page after a stale cursor or once the session is idle.
RunnerRequest_get_messages_page.title: RunnerRequest_get_messages_page

RunnerRequest_get_session_lease.description:
Usage: Probe session lease ownership.
Inputs: Supply sessionIds.
Invariants: Held and unknown are separate classifications; unknown is not proof of an available lease.
Effects: Reads lease state without taking a lease.
Recovery: Probe again when unknown ownership can be resolved.
RunnerRequest_get_session_lease.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_lease

RunnerRequest_get_session_stats.description:
Usage: Read session usage statistics.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: Statistics describe the current session snapshot.
Effects: Reads usage without changing the session.
Recovery: Refresh after further activity.
RunnerRequest_get_session_stats.title: RunnerRequest_get_session_stats

RunnerRequest_get_state.description:
Usage: Read live session state.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current in-process snapshot, not a durable history or completion guarantee.
Effects: Reads model, queue, goal, tools and activity state without submitting work.
Recovery: Refresh after reconnecting or when state changes.
RunnerRequest_get_state.title: RunnerRequest_get_state

RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages.description:
Usage: Incrementally read an owned subagent transcript.
Inputs: Identify it by subagentId or sessionFile; fromByte defaults to zero and is a UTF-8 byte offset.
Invariants: Only current-session-owned transcripts are accessible; only newline-complete entries advance nextByte. An offset past EOF resets to zero.
Effects: Reads the transcript file without modifying it; messages are the message entries in order.
Recovery: Resume at nextByte; on reset discard the old view and rebuild from zero.

fromByte.description: UTF-8 byte offset; defaults to zero and is truncated to a nonnegative integer.

sessionFile.description: Previously observed transcript path owned by the current session.

subagentId.description: Observed subagent id; when supplied it takes precedence over sessionFile.

RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagent_messages

RunnerRequest_get_subagents.description:
Usage: Inspect the current session's observed subagent roster.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: The in-memory roster only knows lifecycle events observed since watching began, ordered by index then id.
Effects: Returns a snapshot without changing subagents.
Recovery: Refresh the snapshot; it is not a durable complete history.
RunnerRequest_get_subagents.title: RunnerRequest_get_subagents

RunnerRequest_get_tree.description:
Usage: Read the session tree and current leaf.
Inputs: No arguments.
Invariants: This is a current session snapshot and can change with navigation.
Effects: Reads the in-process tree without modifying it.

RunnerRequest_get_tree.title: RunnerRequest_get_tree

RunnerRequest_goal.description:
Usage: Read or control the session goal.

Effects: Mutating operations change goal continuation state.

RunnerRequest_goal.title: RunnerRequest_goal

RunnerRequest_handoff.description:
Usage: Compact the current session with an OMP handoff summary.
Inputs: Optional string customInstructions guides the summary.
Invariants: Compaction runs in the background without interrupting an active response. OMP rejects overlapping compaction or a session transition.
Effects: Updates the current session's context, not a separate session. The runner waits for compaction to finish before replying with {}; compaction errors fail the command.
Recovery: If delivery is uncertain, inspect session state and manual_compaction_end before retrying.
RunnerRequest_handoff.title: RunnerRequest_handoff

RunnerRequest_live_connect.description:
Usage: Connect live voice using a remote WebRTC offer.
Inputs: sdpOffer must be nonempty; voice and instructions are optional.
Invariants: Dictation must not be active; the returned SDP answer belongs to this connection.
Effects: Starts live voice without opening the runner microphone.

RunnerRequest_live_mute.description:
Usage: Control live microphone mute.

RunnerRequest_live_start.description:
Usage: Start live voice using the runner microphone.
Inputs: voice and instructions are optional.

Effects: Opens a live voice connection and microphone; delegated work uses session tools.

RunnerRequest_live_start.title: RunnerRequest_live_start

RunnerRequest_live_stop.description:

RunnerRequest_live_stop.title: RunnerRequest_live_stop

RunnerRequest_login.description:
Usage: Authenticate an OAuth provider interactively.
Inputs: providerId names a known provider; answer numeric-id prompts with login_input_response.

RunnerRequest_login.title: RunnerRequest_login

RunnerRequest_logout.description:
Usage: Remove a stored provider credential.
Inputs: providerId and integer credentialId identify the account.

Effects: Removes the credential and updates session authentication.

RunnerRequest_logout.title: RunnerRequest_logout

RunnerRequest_navigate_tree.description:
Usage: Navigate the session tree, optionally summarizing the abandoned branch.
Inputs: Supply entryId and optional summarize and customInstructions.

RunnerRequest_navigate_tree.title: RunnerRequest_navigate_tree

RunnerRequest_new_session.description:
Usage: Create a session, optionally linked to a parent.

RunnerRequest_open_session.description:

Effects: May switch or create a session and select its model.

RunnerRequest_open_session.title: RunnerRequest_open_session

RunnerRequest_predict_word.description:
Usage: Request composer ghost text.

RunnerRequest_predict_word_feedback.description:
